issues.description: table() crashes with TypeError for empty result sets, breaking empty usage/failure/top reports.
Failed ingests still commit valid rows before enforcing the malformed-row threshold.
Out-of-memory jobs using Slurm's OUT_OF_MEMORY state are omitted from failure reports.
Timestamps are accepted as mixed naive/offset ISO strings without canonical normalization.
Timestamp filtering and MAX() use lexicographic TEXT comparisons, which misorder offset-aware timestamps.
Report commands silently create and initialize a new empty database when --db points to a typo or missing path.
GPU TRES parsing accepts negative counts and bogus keys such as gres/gpufoo.
Argument parsing errors raise SystemExit with a string, producing exit code 1 instead of conventional CLI usage code 2.
Ingest only handles RowParseError, so unreadable files, decode errors, and SQLite errors produce raw tracebacks.
The default SQLite database is created with process umask permissions, which may expose user/job accounting data on shared systems.
parse_file accumulates the full import in memory before writing, which will not scale well for large sacct exports.
